personalInfo.bio: I’m a Software Engineer who enjoys building things from the ground up — designing clean interfaces, architecting scalable backends, and connecting everything in between. I work with full-stack systems, SaaS, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure, always looking for better ways to turn ideas into reliable products.And when I’m not coding for work, I’m busy building my own startup — so I guess I’m an aspiring entrepreneur too. :)
